analysis.headline: Shares Your Data for Ads
analysis.quote: Based on data such as IP address, hashed user ID, and your general location (your country or city), some of our Applications serve targeted ads. These ads are provided by our monetization partners.

analysis.headline: AI Processes Your Chat Inputs
analysis.quote: Your input (which means anything that you choose to type into Aria’s chatbox, including any personal data you choose to include) is first processed by Aria to understand how to build the best possible answer. Based on your prompt, Aria selects and shares it with either OpenAI or Google to generate a response, depending on which model is best suited for your request.

analysis.headline: Third Parties Collect Your Data
analysis.quote: Most of these extensions are developed by third parties and are subject to their own privacy terms. Please carefully review the terms before installing extensions.

analysis.headline: Tracks Your General Location
analysis.quote: When you interact with these features, we collect some information, such as the articles you read in the News Feed, and your general location (your city or country).

analysis.headline: Extensive Feature Usage Tracking
analysis.quote: We collect this identifier, as well as Machine ID, hardware specifications (model, release date, etc.), operating system, environment configuration, and feature usage data to improve our products and services.

analysis.headline: Retains Usage Data for Years
analysis.quote: We retain this usage data for up to three years.

analysis.headline: Shares Data with Affiliates
analysis.quote: News applications like Apex News and Apex Football are offered by our affiliate, Opera Technology Singapore Pte. Ltd.

analysis.headline: Payment Data Linked to Account
analysis.quote: To enable payouts, your Opera account will be linked with a payment service provider, which will receive your customer ID, and relevant payment related data with Opera.

analysis.headline: Builds Your Interest Profile
analysis.quote: We use this information to build a profile of your interests, which we use only to select more relevant content for you.
